SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
MONDAY - AUGUST 14, 2023 - 08:30 A.M.
EMERALD ROOM - SHERATON CERRITOS HOTEL
12725 CENTER COURT DRIVE SOUTH, CERRITOS, CA 90703
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at www.cerritos.us and at the Office of the City Clerk, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 1st floor, Cerritos, CA, during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the legislative body after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection in the Office of the City Clerk during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by phone at (562) 916-1248 during regular business hours.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting in-person at the location listed on the agenda.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in person at the meeting or by using the following alternate methods:
Written correspondence (hard copy or email): Public comments can be submitted via email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by hard copy to the Office the City Clerk no later than 12:00 p.m. on Friday, August 11, 2023. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 12:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the legislative body prior to the meeting. During the meeting, your name and summary comments will be read into the record. The document will be retained with the public record of the meeting.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 916-1248 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.

Public Comments
This section is reserved for comments related to the items listed on this Special Meeting agenda only. Comments are limited to 5 minutes per person.
5.

5A.
PUBLIC EMPLOYMENT
Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957(b) (COUNCIL)
Title: Position of City Manager
5B.
PUBLIC EMPLOYEE APPOINTMENT
Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957(b) (COUNCIL)
Title: City Manager
Closed Session Report
If the City Council adjourns to Closed Session, the City Council will reconvene into Open Session after its conclusion and designated City staff will provide a verbal report on any reportable action taken. This report will be memorialized in the official meeting minutes.
6.
Adjournment
minutes_text:
MINUTES OF A SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL HELD MONDAY,
AUGUST 14, 2023, 8:30 A.M., IN THE EMERALD ROOM AT THE SHERATON CERRITOS HOTEL
12725 CENTER COURT DRIVE SOUTH, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA.

 1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 8:30 a.m.

 2.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Mayor Pro Tem Solanki.

 3.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council were in attendance:

  Councilmember Lynda P. Johnson
  Councilmember Chuong Vo
  Councilmember Frank Aurelio Yokoyama (arrived at approximately 8:55 a.m.)
  Mayor Pro Tem Naresh Solanki
  Mayor Bruce W. Barrows (arrived at approximately 9:35 a.m.)

 4.  Public Comments

  The public comments period was opened. Noting there were no individuals who elected to
  provide public comment, the public comments period was declared closed.

 5.  Closed Session

  Bill Ihrke, City Attorney, announced the City Council would recess to Closed Session to
  discuss the following items as listed on the Closed Session agenda.

  5A.  PUBLIC EMPLOYMENT
  Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957(b) (COUNCIL)
  Title: Position of City Manager

  5B.  PUBLIC EMPLOYEE APPOINTMENT
  Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957(b) (COUNCIL)
  Title: City Manager

  The City Council recessed to Closed Session.

  CLOSED SESSION REPORT:

  The City Council reconvened into Open Session. Bill Ihrke, City Attorney, reported the City
  Council recessed into Closed Session to discuss Items 5A and 5B as listed on the Closed
  Session agenda. No reportable action was taken on either item and there was nothing
  further to report.

 6.  Adjournment

  The meeting adjourned at 5:11 p.m.
  /s/Vida Barone  ______
  Vida Barone, City Clerk
 ATTEST:

  /s/Bruce W. Barrows
 Bruce W. Barrows, Mayor

 APPROVED: August 24, 2023
